create_horizontal_video_stack: create a VideoAugmenterByStack with hstack orientation to stack two videos side by side
create_vertical_video_stack: create a VideoAugmenterByStack with vstack orientation to stack two videos on top of each other
stack_videos_with_first_audio: stack two videos together using the first video audio by setting use_second_audio to False
stack_videos_with_second_audio: stack two videos together using the second video audio by setting use_second_audio to True
get_ffmpeg_stack_command: call get_command on VideoAugmenterByStack to generate the FFmpeg CLI command for stacking two videos
